scripts.title: GR Hub Luau
scripts.code:
local INTERFACE_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PequenoGR/Gr_Script/refs/heads/main/InterfaceScript"

local ok, err = pcall(function()
    local source = game:HttpGet(INTERFACE_URL)
    if not source or source == "" then
        error("Não foi possível baixar a interface (fonte vazia).")
    end
    local fn, compileErr = loadstring(source)
    if not fn then
        error("Erro ao compilar interface: " .. tostring(compileErr))
    end
    fn()
end)

if not ok then
    warn("[GR Hub] Falha ao carregar a interface: " .. tostring(err))
    return
end

-- ===== Aguarda a API global ficar disponível (com timeout) =====
local Hub = getgenv().GRHub
if not Hub then
    local tries = 0
    repeat
        task.wait(0.1)
        tries = tries + 1
        Hub = getgenv().GRHub
    until Hub or tries >= 50
end

if not Hub then
    warn("[GR Hub] A API (getgenv().GRHub) não foi exposta pela interface.")
    return
end

-- ===== Services =====
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local VirtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local State = {
    AutoFarmArea  = false,
    SelectedArea  = "Secreto",
    AutoFarmPlot  = false,
    AutoPortal    = false,
    AutoAdminCoin = false,
    AntiAFK       = false,
}

local FarmManager = {}

function FarmManager.SetArea(areaName)
    State.SelectedArea = areaName
end

function FarmManager.ToggleAutoFarmArea(active)
    State.AutoFarmArea = active
    if active then
        task.spawn(function()
            while State.AutoFarmArea do
                task.wait(1)
                -- sua lógica de farm aqui
            end
        end)
    end
end

function FarmManager.ToggleAutoFarmPlot(active)
    State.AutoFarmPlot = active
end

function FarmManager.ToggleAutoPortal(active)
    State.AutoPortal = active
end

local EventManager = {}

function EventManager.ToggleAdminCoin(active)
    State.AutoAdminCoin = active
end

function EventManager.ClaimReward()
    -- sua lógica de coletar recompensa
end

local PlayerManager = {}

function PlayerManager.ResetCharacter()
    if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        player.Character.Humanoid.Health = 0
    end
end

local ConfigManager = {}

function ConfigManager.ToggleAntiAFK(active)
    State.AntiAFK = active
    if active then
        player.Idled:Connect(function()
            if State.AntiAFK then
                VirtualUser:CaptureController()
                VirtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new())
            end
        end)
    end
end

-- ===== Abas =====
Hub.AddTab("Main",   "Main",   "rbxassetid://78780430891192")
Hub.AddTab("Player", "Player", "rbxassetid://6031763426")
Hub.AddTab("Config", "Config", "rbxassetid://6031280882")

-- ===== Página Main =====
local farmSection = Hub.CreateSection("Main", "FARMING")

Hub.CreateToggle(farmSection, "Auto Farm (Áreas)", FarmManager.ToggleAutoFarmArea)

Hub.CreateDropdown(farmSection, "Área", {
    {Name = "Secreto"},
    {Name = "Divino"},
    {Name = "Celestial"},
    {Name = "Abisal"},
    {Name = "Transcendent"},
}, function(info)
    FarmManager.SetArea(info.Name)
end)

Hub.CreateToggle(farmSection, "Farm Plots (Seu terreno)", FarmManager.ToggleAutoFarmPlot)
Hub.CreateToggle(farmSection, "Auto Portal 4x", FarmManager.ToggleAutoPortal)

local eventSection = Hub.CreateSection("Main", "EVENTO")

Hub.CreateToggle(eventSection, "Farm Evento (AdminCoin)", EventManager.ToggleAdminCoin)
Hub.CreateButton(eventSection, "Coletar Recompensa Rápida", EventManager.ClaimReward)

-- ===== Página Player =====
local playerSection = Hub.CreateSection("Player", "ATRIBUTOS")
Hub.CreateButton(playerSection, "Resetar Personagem", PlayerManager.ResetCharacter)

-- ===== Página Config =====
local configSection = Hub.CreateSection("Config", "GERAL")

Hub.CreateToggle(configSection, "Anti-AFK", ConfigManager.ToggleAntiAFK)

Hub.CreateDropdown(configSection, "Tamanho Janela", {
    {Name = "Pequeno", X = 380, Y = 260},
    {Name = "Médio",   X = 480, Y = 320},
    {Name = "Grande",  X = 560, Y = 380},
}, function(info)
    Hub.SetWindowSize(info.X, info.Y)
end)

scripts.title: Luau Speed & Fly Utility
scripts.description: Script utilitário em Luau com controle suave de movimentação, teleporte e notificações no console.
scripts.code:
--[[
    Luau Utility Script v2.4
    Hospedado via ScriptsGR
    Exemplo compatível com loadstring(game:HttpGet(...))()
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local function notify(title, text)
    print(string.format("[%s]: %s", title, text))
end

notify("ScriptsGR", "Script carregado com sucesso pelo loadstring!")

-- Exemplo de função utilitária
local function setWalkSpeed(speed)
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.WalkSpeed = speed
        notify("Velocidade", "Ajustada para " .. tostring(speed))
    end
end

setWalkSpeed(24)
return { version = "2.4.0", status = "active" }
